elements.description:
Match a file's columns to your fields: a model's suggestion per column with its confidence in words, a select of
fields (or Don't import) per column, required fields left out and duplicates in words, and Accept all suggestions.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quiet line under the heading – the file, or what the rows become

properties.name: fields
properties.description: The fields the rows are imported into

properties.name: suggestions
properties.description: The model's suggestion per column, with how sure it is

properties.name: mapping
properties.description: The value: column id → field id, null for "Don't import". Columns left out use their suggestion. Changed unless a tc-mapping-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: hideContinue
properties.description: Hides Continue, for a page with its own next step

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Words the page can rename, merged over defaultColumnMapperLabels

properties.name: resolved
properties.description: Every column's field, suggestions filled in

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-mapping-change
events.description: A column's field was changed, or every suggestion accepted ({ mapping, column, field }: ColumnMappingChange); cancelable – prevented, `mapping` stays as it was

events.name: tc-continue
events.description: Continue was pressed with every required field matched and no field matched twice ({ mapping }: ColumnMapperContinue)

functions.name: confidenceLevel
functions.description: High at 0.85 and above, Medium at 0.6 and above, Low below

functions.name: resolveMapping
functions.signature: resolveMapping(columns: ColumnMapperColumn[], mapping: ColumnMapping, suggestions: ColumnMapperSuggestion[]): ColumnMapping
functions.description: Every column's field: the mapping's, else its suggestion's, else null

functions.name: mappingProblems
functions.signature: mappingProblems(columns: ColumnMapperColumn[], fields: ColumnMapperField[], mapping: ColumnMapping): void
functions.description: What's wrong with a mapping: required fields nothing goes to, and fields more than one column goes to

props.name: mapping
props.description: Column id → field id, null for "Don't import". Controlled when defined – pass back what onMappingChange reports

props.name: defaultMapping
props.description: The starting mapping when uncontrolled; columns left out use their suggestion

props.name: onMappingChange
props.type: (mapping: ColumnMapping, column: string | null, field: string | null) => void
props.description: A column's field changed, or every suggestion was accepted: the whole mapping, the column (null for all) and its field

props.name: onContinue
props.description: Continue was pressed with every required field matched

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
